meta.name: SoC PIO
meta.description: A parallel input/output port of a SoC: up to 32 input, output or bidirectional bits a program reads and writes over its SoC bus, with optional edge capture and an interrupt output

bus.label: Bus
bus.title: The SoC bus the PIO answers on

startAddress.label: Start address (hex)
startAddress.title: Address of the first register; the PIO answers 24 bytes from there (word access only)

width.label: Number of bits
width.title: Number of I/O bits (1 to 32); each bit has its own pin

direction.label: Direction
direction.title: Which pins the port has: inputs (bottom), outputs (top), both, or bidirectional pins whose direction register chooses

outputResetValue.label: Output reset value (hex)
outputResetValue.title: Value of the output register after a reset

outputBitOps.label: Output bit set/clear
outputBitOps.title: Adds the outset (offset 0x10) and outclear (offset 0x14) registers, which set or clear the output bits written as 1

syncCapture.label: Synchronous capture
syncCapture.title: Adds the edge capture register (offset 0x0C), which remembers the input bits that changed

captureEdge.label: Capture type
captureEdge.title: Which input changes the edge capture register records

captureBitClear.label: Capture bit clearing
captureBitClear.title: On: writing the edge capture register clears only the bits written as 1; off: any write clears it all

genIrq.label: IRQ output
genIrq.title: Adds the IRQ pin and the interrupt mask register (offset 0x08)

irqType.label: IRQ type
irqType.title: Level: an unmasked input that is 1 raises the IRQ; edge: an unmasked bit of the edge capture register does

cExport.label: C header
cExport.title: Writes a C driver for this configuration: <NAME>.h and <NAME>.c with a setter / getter per register

status.label: Status
status.title: The address range the PIO answers and its register values

status.notConnected: Not connected to a bus: choose one in the Bus attribute

cExport.generated: Logic Design Studio automatically generated file for a PIO component
cExport.outputData:
With the following function the output values of the PIO can be set.
This function takes the new output value as parameter "value".
Note: only the lower {{bits}} bits of the parameter "value" are used.
cExport.inputData:
With the following function the input values of the PIO can be read out.
This function returns the respective value.
Note: only the lower {{bits}} bits are valid.
cExport.direction:
With the following functions the direction register can be set or read out:
a 1 makes the respective bit an output, a 0 makes it an input.
Note: only the lower {{bits}} bits are used.
cExport.irqMask:
With the following functions the interrupt mask register can be set or read out.
A 1 on a position means an interrupt is generated when the {{source}} is 1.
Note: only the lower {{bits}} bits are used.
cExport.irqEdge: corresponding bit of the edge capture register
cExport.edgeCapture:
With the following functions the edge capture register can be cleared or read out.
A 1 on a position means the respective input has had {{edge}},
otherwise it has not changed.

Writing to this register will {{clear}}.
Note: only the lower {{bits}} bits are used.

capture.rising: at least one change from 0 to 1
capture.falling: at least one change from 1 to 0
capture.any: at least one change from 0 to 1 or from 1 to 0

cExport.clearBits: clear the bits of the capture register that are 1 in the parameter "value"
cExport.clearAll: clear all bits of the capture register whatever the parameter "value" is
cExport.outSet:
With the following function the outputs whose bits are 1 in the parameter "value" are set to 1.
Note: only the lower {{bits}} bits are used.
cExport.outClear:
With the following function the outputs whose bits are 1 in the parameter "value" are cleared to 0.
Note: only the lower {{bits}} bits are used.

circ.idTooLong: The bus id in the file is longer than {{max}} characters: the PIO is not connected to a bus
circ.badStartAddress: "{{value}}" is not a 32-bit start address: 0x0 is used
circ.badWidth: "{{value}}" is not a number of bits ({{min}} to {{max}}): {{used}} is used
circ.badDirection: "{{value}}" is not a direction (bidir, inputonly, outputonly or inout): {{used}} is used
circ.badOutputResetValue: "{{value}}" is not a 32-bit output reset value: 0x0 is used
circ.badCaptureEdge: "{{value}}" is not a capture type (rising, falling or any): {{used}} is used
circ.badIrqType: "{{value}}" is not an IRQ type (level or edge): {{used}} is used
